Wx.bar_b_note: Large, grounded turtle with detailed plated shell matches the owner bar's naturalistic finish.

Fn.bar_b_note: Neon magenta emissive tendrils dominate and read as an effect rather than a naturalistic creature.

Us.bar_b_note: Glossy vinyl-blue skin with regular white dots reads toy-like next to the owner bar's fur and scale detail.

Ki.bar_b_note: Muddy brown and gold surface loses the head at small size, and a stray spike shows in the faint frames.

Wj.bar_b_note: Smeared ground textures, flat light with no fog depth, and sparse scattered props sink it; B also leaves enemy banners standing after the win.

Aa.bar_b_note: Real-looking fur and a clear face carry it, though it barely out-stands the trainer.

Ly.bar_b_note: Big readable frog silhouette with a believable spotted skin, clear eyes and good scale against the ruler.

Td.bar_b_note: B's naturalistic mottled scales and grounded coiled faint carry it; A's cartoon bands and floating faint would sink it.

Ta.bar_b_note: Glossy flat purple with little surface breakup, and a standing height below the trainer's head.

Jr.bar_b_note: Appealing, expressive villager with a natural olive and tan palette, though more cartoon than the creatures.

Nz.bar_b_note: Lumpy bark-like fur clumps read as rock, and the boar stands below the trainer's height.

Ds.bar_b_note: Strong drake silhouette and colour carry it, but the ridden frame shows no rider and the faint end goes pancake-flat.

Bo.bar_b_note: Armoured, spiky silhouette is readable and well detailed; the flat opaque water slab with the trainer standing on it hurts the swim frame.

Cm.bar_b_note: Naturalistic dark feathered owl with readable hurt and faint poses, in line with the Galecrest bar.

Qy.bar_b_note: A lone, thin free-standing panel beside a faceted placeholder boulder on smeared ground reads as a prototype, not a Palworld-class base piece.

top_changes.change: World scenes (Wj, Qy): replace smeared ground textures with crisp terrain materials, add atmospheric fog and depth grading plus warm directional light, and cluster props into authored camps rather than scattered pieces.
Give the homestead wall real thickness, mid-value textured infill (wattle, plank or plaster with grime), and a joined post, cap and footing build that tiles into a run.

Creature pass: keep faint poses grounded (Td A), show the rider in ridden frames (Ds), fix the swim water slab and the trainer standing on it (Bo), remove the Ki spike artefact, scale up Ta, Nz and Aa to clearly out-stand the 1.80 m trainer, and tone down glossy and emissive materials (Fn, Us, Ta) toward the naturalistic bar.
